caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular field with stepped extensions on the right side, filled with a blue background and a pattern of white floral and leaf motifs. The pattern includes a large central flower surrounded by smaller flowers and multiple stylized leaves arranged symmetrically around it. On the left edge of the pattern, there is a smaller rectangular section bordered with a dotted outline and containing an abstract geometric motif. The floral elements are made up of thick, textured white lines with inner detailing, contrasting with the solid blue background. The entire composition is set inside a plain, unadorned white border with no additional decorative elements.
title: Coverlet
